metadata.title: BioMy India-relevant temporal starter catalog
metadata.warning: Not a prescribing database. Verify every parameter against authoritative clinical sources before use.

drugs.name: Paracetamol
drugs.age_restriction: Dose is age- and weight-dependent; children require weight-based clinical guidance.
side_effects: rare serious liver injury with overdose

drugs.name: Ibuprofen
drugs.age_restriction: Avoid unsupervised use in young children, dehydration, kidney disease, or pregnancy risk contexts.

drugs.name: Warfarin
drugs.age_restriction: Requires INR monitoring and clinician supervision.

drugs.name: Phenytoin
drugs.age_restriction: Therapeutic drug monitoring and clinician supervision required.

drugs.name: Metformin
drugs.age_restriction: Renal function and acute illness must be reviewed.

drugs.name: Amlodipine
drugs.age_restriction: Blood pressure, age, and comorbidities affect safe use.

drugs.name: Midazolam
drugs.age_restriction: Prescription-only sedative; respiratory monitoring is required.

drugs.name: Atorvastatin
drugs.age_restriction: Contraindicated in pregnancy; liver and interaction review required.

drugs.name: Digoxin
drugs.age_restriction: Narrow therapeutic index; kidney function and monitoring required.

herbs.name: Piperine
herbs.age_restriction: Supplement concentration and interactions vary; children require professional review.

herbs.name: Ashwagandha
herbs.age_restriction: Avoid unsupervised use in pregnancy, thyroid disease, or children.

herbs.name: Curcumin
herbs.age_restriction: Preparation and dose vary; anticoagulant use requires review.

herbs.name: Ginger
herbs.age_restriction: Food use differs from concentrated supplements; anticoagulant review may be needed.

herbs.name: Garlic
herbs.age_restriction: Concentrated supplements may increase bleeding risk.
